scripts.build: node scripts/build_css.js && browserify -t brfs app/core/entry/entry.js -p glslify-require -o dist/bundle.js && uglifyjs dist/bundle.js -m -o dist/bundle.js
scripts.dev: node scripts/build_css.js && npm run build && concurrently -k -n BUNDLE,ELECTRON "npm run serve" "electron ."
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run generate:icon && electron-packager . "StormTrack Pro" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=images/STP_icon.ico --out=release --overwrite
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run generate:icon && electron-builder --win
